candidates.title: Self-charging toothbrush zaps cavity bacteria with electricity from bending bristles
candidates.summary: Peking Univ. School of Stomatology: PVDF piezoelectric bristles make charge when bent -> reactive oxygen species in saliva damage bacteria; lab: ~53% S. mutans killed vs 9% nylon (78% of a gum-disease bacterium); 3-month trial of 115 volunteers: less plaque, gum inflammation, bleeding vs nylon; experts: more testing needed; Science Advances
candidates.note: Peer-reviewed (Science Advances) + Nature news + Live Science + EurekAlert; 99% plaque and 40%/15% figures excluded (single/secondary sources); health framing kept non-advisory
